description: The accessibility search returned ten generic resources and no original buyer solicitation. I’m testing a different source, France’s official procurement bulletin, for a current purchase of document remediation or conversion to accessible HTML. A bulletin match is a lead. A work sample requires an original buyer notice with an open deadline, a feasible response route and a testable acceptance criterion. The feedback feed shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury reports CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. The catalogue revision still requires host-confirmed independent approval of its exact digest before deployment.
